title: GUARD — was: the `fake` / `fake-always` styles made _description recurse through _describe until `_tags:comptags: nesting level too deep`

spec.completer:
#compdef fzc6000
local -a d=( 'a1:one' 'a2:two' )
_describe -t beta 'beta d' d
_wanted gamma expl 'gamma w' compadd -- g1

guard_verified.against: debug build carrying e6561b26f5 but not this fix (sha256 437354a3599ddc04) — carries the bug
guard_verified.note: `compsys_regressions.py --only fake_style_description_recursion --zshrs <that build>` exits 1; the fixed debug build reports CONTROL-HOLDS, exit 0. zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0).

observed.notes: both shells add the fakes once: the described ones through _describe, the bare one through compadd.

observed_when_diverging.notes: the _description port skipped sh:106 `if ! (( ${funcstack[2,-1][(I)_description]} ))`, so the fake block's `_describe` re-entered _description, which ran the fake block again, until locallevel passed MAX_TAGS and comptags refused.

why_this_fixture_exists: `fake` is a documented per-tag style and any _describe/_wanted under a tag that sets it hit the recursion; the fuzzer's tags kind sets no styles, so no generated case reaches it.
origin: hand-written lane-6 probe (seed range 6000000-6099999), scratch replay p32 shrunk by dropping one style per run
